description: Ten Persons with Developmental Disabilities packages measure access to support services. They cover active and historical caseload, age and legal-authority breakdowns, service type, delivery model, family-managed and provider-managed services by region, service costs and waiting lists. Delivery includes family-managed agreements, contracted community providers and government-operated facilities. Historical active caseload runs April 2010–May 2018; age breakdown begins April 2011; most current components start April or June 2018, and legal authority starts March 2020. Their native end is December 2021. Service-type caseload is monthly and costs quarterly; other resolutions are unstated. XLSX tables/dictionaries and PDF visualisations/maps are listed. These are service demand and delivery measures, not clinical disability incidence. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the original source identity and metadata. Source coverage is Alberta unless the described component explicitly includes Canada. The native licence field states Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual access and costs are unverified. No linked dataset, document, workbook, archive, installer, code or legal text was fetched. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown.
